// Control case: Execute accepts a VerifiedOffer produced by the SDK verify path.
// This file must compile, which shows that a failure of the other cases comes
// from the guard and not from the way the test builds them.
package main

import (
	"context"

	foraconnect "github.com/FORA-Protocol/protocol/sdk/go/connect"
	"github.com/FORA-Protocol/protocol/sdk/go/core"
)

func guard(client *foraconnect.Client, res core.Result) {
	_, _ = client.Execute(context.Background(), res.Verified[0])
}

func main() { guard(nil, core.Result{}) }
